ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-Setup.exe](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.0.0/ChurchStream-Setup.exe)** (installer, recommended) · or [ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.0.0/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip) (no installer, e.g. for a USB stick) |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.0.0/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v1.0.0/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

The other files on this page (`ChurchStream-app-…`, `ffmpeg-…`, `update.json`) are for ChurchStream's own updates; you don't need to download them.

**Coming from an earlier version?** This is the last time you need to download the whole program.
- **Windows:** run **ChurchStream-Setup.exe**. When it asks, choose your old ChurchStream folder and your settings, songs and services come along.
- **Mac:** replace ChurchStream.app in Applications with the new one. Your settings in ChurchStream-data are kept.

## New in 1.0.0

ChurchStream 1.0: an installer for Windows, and updates that look after themselves.

### Updates, without downloading everything again
- ChurchStream now checks by itself for a newer version, when it starts and every few hours. A card appears in the corner of the control panel and the stream page: **What's new · Update · Later**.
- **Update** downloads only what changed: usually a few MB instead of the whole 50–100 MB program. Then **Restart now** (about 10 seconds), or the new version starts next time. Phones and tablets reconnect by themselves.
- Nothing is downloaded until someone clicks **Update**, and never during a live stream or recording: the card waits until the stream ends.
- Each download is checked before it is used. If an update ever fails to start, ChurchStream goes back to the version you had and says so.
- **Settings → Advanced → Updates** checks by hand, or turns the checks off.

### An installer for Windows
- **ChurchStream-Setup.exe** installs ChurchStream for you, with no administrator password, and adds **ChurchStream** to the Start menu (and the desktop if you like) and an uninstaller in **Settings → Apps**.
- Settings, songs, services and recordings now live in **ChurchStream-data in your user folder**, so uninstalling or reinstalling never touches them. It can bring the settings of an older ChurchStream folder along.
- The zip without an installer is still here for USB sticks and computers where you can't install.

### Also since 0.5.0
- The video and music feed into the stream uses less computer power between videos, and a playing video's sound and picture now line up within about 30 ms.
- The installer, the update process and the Mac app's recording are tested automatically on real Windows and Mac machines before each release.

**Not code-signed:** Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* for the installer; click **More info → Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the README if it says the app can't be opened.

**Please try the installer on your church computer** before Sabbath.

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
